control.description-key: Edits a delimited text column as tags, optionally synchronized with a Tag table and a Bridge table

property.name: value
property.description-key: Text column that stores the delimited tag list

property.name: tagTable
property.description-key: Logical name of the Tag table, e.g. gm_tag

property.name: tagNameColumn
property.description-key: Logical name of the Tag name column, e.g. gm_name

property.name: bridgeTable
property.description-key: Logical name of the Bridge table, e.g. gm_accounttag. Leave empty for text-only mode

property.name: bridgeTargetLookup
property.description-key: Lookup column on the Bridge table pointing to this table, e.g. gm_accountid

property.name: bridgeTagLookup
property.description-key: Lookup column on the Bridge table pointing to the Tag table, e.g. gm_tagid

property.name: caseInsensitive
property.description-key: Treat Vip and vip as the same tag, default Yes

property.name: syncTextOnLoad
property.display-name-key: Sync text to Dataverse on load
property.description-key: Create Bridge rows for tags found in the text column but missing in Dataverse, default Yes

property.name: config
property.description-key: Optional JSON configuration. Individual properties override it

property.name: entityId
property.description-key: Leave empty on forms: the record id is read from the form

property.name: entityName
property.description-key: Leave empty on forms: the table name is read from the form
